name: Meridian Endurance
_brief: Rewritten against a REAL Whop Content Rewards campaign (whop.com/contentrewards), not invented. Live campaigns there carry: a one-line pitch, a category and type, per-platform CPM with a min and max per submission, a total budget with a paid-out meter, an average review time, content requirements, and a linked campaign brief. Everything below mirrors that shape so the engine is building against the structure clippers actually see.

whop._payoutNote: Observed live: $1.00 per 1k views, $1 min and $500 max per submission, identical across all four platforms. A clipper is paid on VIEWS, which is why hook strength and swipe-through matter more to them than craft — and why our quality gates should optimise for the first slide above all.

rules._canvasNote: 1080x1920 added because every Whop campaign observed pays on TikTok and YouTube as well as Instagram, at the same CPM. Shipping 4:5 only forfeits three of four payable platforms.

contentRequirements._note: Whop campaigns state these as a short list and link a fuller brief. Ours are machine-checkable, which is the thing the validator already enforces.
